headline: TotalEnergies Q3 Adjusted Net Profit Doubles to $9.1 Billion
summary: TotalEnergies booked $9.1 billion in third-quarter adjusted net income, up 127% year-on-year. Strong trading alongside higher refining margins, oil, and gas prices propelled the earnings gain.
why: TotalEnergies is a French energy supermajor with global operations spanning oil, natural gas, refining, and renewable power.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies SE
impacts.why: Significant year-over-year earnings growth reinforces financial performance.
